item.title: Porting SixDesk's post-processing to Python and SQL
item.description: This article is part of a short series adapted from my Bachelor's thesis on post-processing routines for long-term beam stability in particle accelerators. Some of the implementation details below reflect SixDesk/SixDeskDB as they stood in 2015-16 and may not match their current state. The previous article in this series walked through postpr, SixTrack's Fortran post-processing subroutine, and the pile of interdependent Bash, AWK and Fortran scripts SixDesk wraps around it to turn a full dynamic-aperture study into a handful of plots.

item.title: SixTrack: tracking particles and post-processing long-term stability data
item.description: This article is part of a short series adapted from my Bachelor's thesis on post-processing routines for long-term beam stability in particle accelerators. The previous article in this series laid out the coordinate systems, Hamiltonian mechanics and beam optics used to describe a particle's motion in an accelerator.

item.title: Particle tracking and beam dynamics in accelerators
item.description: This article is part of a short series adapted from my Bachelor's thesis on post-processing routines for long-term beam stability in particle accelerators. Accelerators have become a key tool for the study of experimental particle physics. Today, thousands of physicists around the world depend on the results generated by the Large Hadron Collider.
